title: Looker Peak Concurrency Tracking
app: Looker System Activity via DB Connect/API; Looker instance logs via UF; plan and query events via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity
| bin _time span=5m
| stats dc(session_id) as concurrent by _time
| timechart span=1h max(concurrent) as peak_concurrency, avg(concurrent) as avg_concurrency
description: Measures concurrent Looker sessions in five-minute buckets and rolls the peak up hourly, revealing the load peaks that drive sizing and licensing decisions.
value: Peak concurrency, not average, determines whether Looker has enough capacity; tracking it prevents peak-hour slowdowns and right-sizes the platform.
implementation: Ingest Looker session events; schedule hourly and alert when peak concurrency approaches the licensed or engineered limit.
visualization: Timechart of Looker peak vs. average concurrency.
grandmaExplanation: We watch how many people use Looker at the same time so it can be sized for the busy periods.
